display_alignment.description: One constant robust-intercept offset is added only for overlay; no rate, curvature, time, or per-block adjustment is applied.

glrt_method.description: Native independent 20 ms robust_cfo_at_reference_hz values with robust line available and the published margin gate passed.

limitations: PSS CFO is an exploratory local estimator and is not part of the standard pipeline.
Three PSS blocks select a visibly different within-symbol frequency-likelihood branch; they remain in all plots and the robust fit.
The PSS and GLRT frequency zeros are different, so only one constant display alignment is applied.
No displayed robust line is a confidence interval or physical-Doppler attribution.
Both methods use the same raw IQ and are not statistically independent evidence.

pss_method.description: Per-continuity-block PSS-only CFO: average normalized within-PSS matched-frequency likelihood, fractional timing interpolation, then refine the nearest 750 Hz alias with inter-frame correlation phase.
